title: HII Sentiment Intelligence Dashboard — Deterministic Evidence-Ledger & Multi-Audience Analytics Architecture
strategy: Design a strictly deterministic, audit-grade sentiment intelligence platform separating LLM-based discovery/classification from pure fixed-point mathematical scoring. A shared, zero-dependency TypeScript engine (`src/engine/`) computes multi-granularity historical scores (2011–2025 annual, 2026 Q1–Q3 quarterly, 2026 Oct/Nov monthly) and 6-month analytical P10/EV/P90 forecasts using integer basis points (10,000 bps = 1.0000) to guarantee zero floating-point drift across architectures. Persistence uses an append-only, SHA-256 content-addressed JSON Evidence Ledger under `data/` exposed via a clean `StorageAdapter` interface and served by a custom Vite dev-server middleware API (`src/server/apiMiddleware.ts`) capable of spawning the Python Vertex AI / Gemini Deep Research pipeline (`research/run_research.py`) while enforcing the $15/month GCP budget guard.

Define all core deterministic domain types and constants:
- `SCORING_ENGINE_VERSION = '1.0.0'`, `RUBRIC_VERSION = '1.0.0'`, `REFERENCE_NOW_ISO = '2026-11-15'`
- `AudienceId = 'executive' | 'congress' | 'navy' | 'public'`
- `ALL_AUDIENCES: readonly AudienceId[] = ['executive', 'congress', 'navy', 'public']`
- `SourceType = 'hearing' | 'gao_report' | 'crs_report' | 'exec_order' | 'budget_request' | 'navy_statement' | 'contract_award' | 'earnings' | 'stock_move' | 'analyst_rating' | 'news_media' | 'legislation'`
- `DirectionCode = -1 | 0 | 1`
- `MagnitudeLevel = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5`
- `CredibilityTier = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4`
- `ScopeClass = 'program' | 'company' | 'industry' | 'macro'`
- `PersistenceClass = 'transient' | 'quarter' | 'year' | 'structural'`
- `DiscreteProbabilityPct = 5 | 10 | 20 | 25 | 30 | 40 | 50 | 60 | 70 | 75 | 80 | 90 | 95`
- `AudienceImpact`: `{ audience: AudienceId; direction: DirectionCode; magnitude: MagnitudeLevel; credibility: CredibilityTier; scope: ScopeClass; persistence: PersistenceClass; rationale: string }`
- `EditAuditEntry`: `{ editedAt: string; author: string; reason: string; previousImpacts: AudienceImpact[]; previousStarred: boolean }`
- `ImpactEvent`: `{ id: string; title: string; eventDate: string; discoveredAt: string; sourceType: SourceType; sourceUrls: string[]; summary: string; starred: boolean; impacts: AudienceImpact[]; editHistory: EditAuditEntry[]; runId?: string }`
- `PeriodGranularity = 'annual' | 'quarterly' | 'monthly'`
- `TimePeriod`: `{ id: string; label: string; granularity: PeriodGranularity; startDate: string; endDate: string; midpointDays: number; isForecast?: boolean }`
- `EventContribution`: `{ eventId: string; title: string; eventDate: string; starred: boolean; rawPointsBps: number; decayMultiplierBps: number; effectivePointsBps: number; shareOfPeriodPct: number }`
- `AudiencePeriodScore`: `{ periodId: string; audience: AudienceId; scoreBps: number; displayScore: number; deltaBps: number; displayDelta: number; contributions: EventContribution[] }`
- `PeriodCompositeRecord`: `{ period: TimePeriod; audiences: Record<AudienceId, AudiencePeriodScore>; compositeScoreBps: number; displayComposite: number; compositeDeltaBps: number; displayCompositeDelta: number; starredEvents: ImpactEvent[]; hasRevision: boolean; revisions: ScoreRevision[] }`
- `AudienceWeights`: `Record<AudienceId, number>` (integers summing to 100)
- `DashboardSettings`: `{ weights: AudienceWeights; referenceDate: string; scoringEngineVersion: string; rubricVersion: string; lastUpdated: string }`
- `ScoreRevision`: `{ id: string; timestamp: string; runId: string; periodId: string; audience: AudienceId | 'composite'; oldScoreBps: number; newScoreBps: number; deltaBps: number; triggeringEventIds: string[]; explanation: string }`
- `ForecastCatalyst`: `{ id: string; title: string; category: 'legislation' | 'appropriations' | 'cr_shutdown' | 'contract_award' | 'budget_request' | 'milestone'; expectedMonth: string; probabilityPct: DiscreteProbabilityPct; summary: string; impacts: AudienceImpact[]; enabled: boolean }`
- `ForecastPoint`: `{ period: TimePeriod; audienceScoresBps: Record<AudienceId, { evBps: number; p10Bps: number; p90Bps: number }>; compositeEvBps: number; compositeP10Bps: number; compositeP90Bps: number; displayEv: number; displayP10: number; displayP90: number; activeCatalystIds: string[] }`
- `ResearchRunRecord`: `{ runId: string; startedAt: string; completedAt?: string; audiences: AudienceId[]; status: 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'budget_blocked'; mode: 'deep_research' | 'grounding_fallback' | 'offline_simulation'; discoveredCount: number; pendingFile?: string; costUsd: number; log: string[] }`
- `LedgerComputationResult`: `{ scoringEngineVersion: string; rubricVersion: string; ledgerHash: string; outputHash: string; computedAt: string; settings: DashboardSettings; timeline: PeriodCompositeRecord[]; forecast: ForecastPoint[]; latestScores: Record<AudienceId | 'composite', { scoreBps: number; displayScore: number; deltaBps: number; displayDelta: number }> }`

Define immutable integer look-up tables (in basis points where 10,000 bps = 1.0000 index points on the 0–100 sentiment scale, baseline neutral = 500,000 bps = 50.00 display score):
- `BASELINE_SCORE_BPS = 500_000` (50.00)
- `MIN_SCORE_BPS = 0` (0.00), `MAX_SCORE_BPS = 1_000_000` (100.00)
- `MAGNITUDE_BASE_BPS: Record<MagnitudeLevel, number>` -> `{ 1: 15_000, 2: 35_000, 3: 65_000, 4: 105_000, 5: 155_000 }` (i.e. +1.5 to +15.5 display points before multipliers)
- `CREDIBILITY_MULT_BPS: Record<CredibilityTier, number>` -> `{ 1: 5_000, 2: 7_500, 3: 9_000, 4: 10_000 }` (Tier 4 = official enacted law/SEC filing/contract = 1.00x; Tier 1 = unverified media = 0.50x)
- `SCOPE_MULT_BPS: Record<ScopeClass, number>` -> `{ program: 7_500, company: 10_000, industry: 6_500, macro: 5_000 }`
- `PERSISTENCE_HALF_LIFE_DAYS: Record<PersistenceClass, number>` -> `{ transient: 45, quarter: 120, year: 365, structural: 1095 }`
- `PERSISTENCE_MAX_HORIZON_DAYS: Record<PersistenceClass, number>` -> `{ transient: 180, quarter: 540, year: 1460, structural: 3650 }`
- Export pure helper `computeRawImpactBps(impact: AudienceImpact): number` using integer math: `Math.trunc((impact.direction * MAGNITUDE_BASE_BPS[impact.magnitude] * CREDIBILITY_MULT_BPS[impact.credibility]) / 10_000 * SCOPE_MULT_BPS[impact.scope] / 10_000)`.
- Export pure helper `computeDecayMultiplierBps(elapsedDays: number, persistence: PersistenceClass): number`: returns `0` if `elapsedDays < 0` or `elapsedDays > PERSISTENCE_MAX_HORIZON_DAYS[persistence]`. Otherwise uses deterministic piecewise-linear octave interpolation of `2^(-elapsedDays / halfLife)` in integer basis points: let `q = Math.floor(elapsedDays / halfLife)` and `r = elapsedDays % halfLife`; integer octave base is `Math.floor(10_000 / (1 << q))`, next octave is `Math.floor(10_000 / (1 << (q + 1)))`, linear interpolation `base - Math.floor(((base - next) * r) / halfLife)`. Pure integer arithmetic only.

Pure deterministic date/period calendar generator:
- `parseIsoDateToEpochDays(isoDate: string): number`: parses `YYYY-MM-DD` strictly in UTC (`Date.UTC(y, m-1, d) / 86_400_000`) with `Math.floor`.
- `buildHistoricalPeriods(referenceDateIso?: string): TimePeriod[]`: Given default `'2026-11-15'`, generates:
  1. Annual periods `2011` through `2025` (`id: '2011'`, `granularity: 'annual'`, `startDate: '2011-01-01'` (`2011-03-31` for 2011 spin-off year), `endDate: 'YYYY-12-31'`).
  2. Quarterly periods for current year `2026`: `'2026-Q1'` (`2026-01-01`..`2026-03-31`), `'2026-Q2'` (`2026-04-01`..`2026-06-30`), `'2026-Q3'` (`2026-07-01`..`2026-09-30`).
  3. Monthly periods within current quarter Q4 2026 up to reference month: `'2026-10'` (`2026-10-01`..`2026-10-31`, label `'Oct 2026'`) and `'2026-11'` (`2026-11-01`..`2026-11-30`, label `'Nov 2026'`).
- `buildForecastPeriods(referenceDateIso?: string): TimePeriod[]`: Generates 6 monthly forward periods starting after Nov 2026: `'2026-12'` (Dec 2026), `'2027-01'` (Jan 2027), `'2027-02'` (Feb 2027), `'2027-03'` (Mar 2027), `'2027-04'` (Apr 2027), `'2027-05'` (May 2027) with `isForecast: true`.

Deterministic canonical JSON serialization and hashing (browser + Node compatible without external crypto dependency):
- Implement pure TypeScript SHA-256 (`sha256Hex(input: string): string`) using standard FIPS 180-4 32-bit integer bitwise operations so it runs identically in browser React and Node CLI without async WebCrypto requirements.
- `canonicalizeJson(value: unknown): string`: recursively sorts object keys lexicographically and serializes arrays in existing order.
- `computeEventContentId(event: Pick<ImpactEvent, 'title' | 'eventDate' | 'sourceType' | 'sourceUrls'>): string`: returns `'evt_' + sha256Hex(canonicalizeJson({ title: event.title.trim(), eventDate: event.eventDate, sourceType: event.sourceType, sourceUrls: [...event.sourceUrls].sort() })).slice(0, 16)`.
- `computeLedgerHash(events: ImpactEvent[], settings: DashboardSettings): string`: sorts events by `id` ascending and hashes canonical representation.

Core deterministic scoring engine (`computeLedgerScores`):
- `validateWeights(weights: AudienceWeights): boolean`: verifies all 4 audiences are integers >= 0 and sum to exactly 100.
- `bpsToDisplay(bps: number): number`: returns `Math.round(bps / 100) / 100` (e.g., `542_500` -> `54.25`).
- `clampScoreBps(bps: number): number`: clamps to `[0, 1_000_000]`.
- `scoreSinglePeriodAudience(period: TimePeriod, audience: AudienceId, sortedEvents: ImpactEvent[], prevScoreBps: number): AudiencePeriodScore`:
  - Evaluates all events where `eventDate <= period.endDate`.
  - Measures `elapsedDays = Math.max(0, parseIsoDateToEpochDays(period.endDate) - parseIsoDateToEpochDays(event.eventDate))` (if event occurs within the period `eventDate >= period.startDate && eventDate <= period.endDate`, `elapsedDays = 0` so full impact is felt in its occurrence period).
  - Computes `rawPointsBps = computeRawImpactBps(impact)`, `decayMultiplierBps = computeDecayMultiplierBps(elapsedDays, impact.persistence)`, `effectivePointsBps = Math.trunc((rawPointsBps * decayMultiplierBps) / 10_000)`.
  - Sums `effectivePointsBps` across all active events in deterministic order (`eventDate ASC, id ASC`), adds to `BASELINE_SCORE_BPS`, and clamps via `clampScoreBps`.
- `computeCompositeBps(audienceScores: Record<AudienceId, AudiencePeriodScore>, weights: AudienceWeights): number`: `Math.trunc((executive * w.executive + congress * w.congress + navy * w.navy + public * w.public) / 100)`.
- `computeLedgerScores(events: ImpactEvent[], settings: DashboardSettings, revisions?: ScoreRevision[]): LedgerComputationResult`: computes full timeline from 2011 to Nov 2026, attaches starred events occurring in each period, attaches matching `ScoreRevision` records, computes latest scores & deltas vs prior period, and stamps `ledgerHash` and `outputHash`.

Retroactive revision detector (`detectRetroactiveRevisions`):
- Signature: `detectRetroactiveRevisions(previousResult: LedgerComputationResult, nextResult: LedgerComputationResult, newlyAddedEvents: ImpactEvent[], runId: string, timestampIso: string): ScoreRevision[]`.
- Compares every historical `periodId` across `ALL_AUDIENCES` and `'composite'`.
- Whenever `oldScoreBps !== newScoreBps`, identifies which events from `newlyAddedEvents` have `eventDate <= period.endDate` and non-zero contribution to that period/audience, and constructs a deterministic `ScoreRevision` record with human-readable `explanation` (e.g., `'Retroactive discovery of GAO report (2024-06-12) adjusted 2024 Congress score by -2.45 pts'`).

Deterministic 6-month scenario-based Expected Value & analytical P10/P90 band calculator (`computeDeterministicForecast`):
- Signature: `computeDeterministicForecast(events: ImpactEvent[], catalysts: ForecastCatalyst[], settings: DashboardSettings, lastHistoricalTimelineRecord: PeriodCompositeRecord): ForecastPoint[]`.
- For each of the 6 forward months (`2026-12` .. `2027-05`):
  1. Computes deterministic baseline trajectory from existing historical `events` decaying forward to `forecastPeriod.endDate`.
  2. Filters active enabled `catalysts` whose `expectedMonth <= forecastPeriod.id`.
  3. For each active catalyst `c` with probability `p = c.probabilityPct` (0..100), computes its decayed impact `impactBps` at `forecastPeriod.endDate`.
  4. **Exact Binary Scenario Enumeration**: Since active catalysts per horizon are typically <= 12, enumerates the exact `2^k` binary outcomes (sorted by catalyst `id` ASC; if `k > 12`, partitions top 12 by absolute magnitude for exact `2^12 = 4096` distribution plus analytical variance for remainder). Every binary state has exact probability weight and exact score impact.
  5. Sorts outcomes by resulting score ascending, accumulates probability mass, and extracts exact **Expected Value (`evBps`)**, **10th percentile (`p10Bps`)**, and **90th percentile (`p90Bps`)** per audience and for the weighted composite. Zero Monte Carlo randomness.

Deterministic Markdown report generator (`generateMarkdownExport`):
- Signature: `generateMarkdownExport(result: LedgerComputationResult, events: ImpactEvent[], catalysts: ForecastCatalyst[], revisions: ScoreRevision[]): string`.
- Outputs structured Markdown containing:
  1. Header & Audit Stamp (`scoringEngineVersion`, `rubricVersion`, `ledgerHash`, `outputHash`, `referenceDate`, Audience Weights table).
  2. Executive Summary: Current Scores (Nov 2026) & Delta vs prior period per audience and Composite.
  3. Complete Historical Score Table (2011–2025 Annual, 2026 Q1–Q3 Quarterly, 2026 Oct–Nov Monthly) with columns for Executive, Congress, Navy, Public, Composite, Delta, and Revision Flags.
  4. 6-Month Deterministic Forecast Table (Dec 2026 – May 2027) with EV and [P10, P90] bands.
  5. Starred Key Events Catalog with dates, source types, and per-audience contribution points.
  6. Period-by-Period Contributing Events Breakdown.
  7. Retroactive Revisions Audit Log.

Node.js filesystem implementation of `StorageAdapter` reading/writing `data/settings.json`, `data/evidence_ledger.json`, `data/catalysts.json`, `data/revisions.json`, `data/runs.json`, and `data/pending/*.json`. Enforces deterministic sorting by `eventDate ASC, id ASC` on save, appends `EditAuditEntry` whenever an existing event's rubric codes change, and invokes `detectRetroactiveRevisions` whenever new or edited evidence alters historical period scores, automatically appending any resulting `ScoreRevision` records to `data/revisions.json`.

Browser implementation of `StorageAdapter` that calls the Vite middleware REST endpoints (`/api/state`, `/api/settings`, `/api/events`, `/api/events/star`, `/api/catalysts`, `/api/research/run`, `/api/pending/approve`, `/api/pending/reject`) with automatic fallback to bundled static JSON imports (`data/*.json`) plus `localStorage` overlay if running as a static preview build.

Vite dev-server middleware plugin (`hiiLocalApiPlugin`) using `LocalJsonStorage` and Node `child_process.spawn`:
- `GET /api/state`: returns full ledger, settings, catalysts, revisions, runs, and pending events.
- `POST /api/settings`: validates integer weights summing to 100 and persists to `data/settings.json`.
- `POST /api/events`: creates or updates an `ImpactEvent` with audit trail and retroactive revision detection.
- `POST /api/events/star`: toggles `starred` flag on an event.
- `POST /api/catalysts`: updates `data/catalysts.json`.
- `POST /api/research/run`: invokes `python3 research/run_research.py --audiences <csv>` (or falls back to deterministic offline discovery simulation if GCP credentials are absent), writes candidate events to `data/pending/`, and logs run telemetry in `data/runs.json`.
- `POST /api/pending/approve`: promotes a pending event into `data/evidence_ledger.json`, computes `detectRetroactiveRevisions` with the research `runId`, records any `ScoreRevision` entries, and removes the item from pending.
- `POST /api/pending/reject`: removes candidate event from pending.

Headless Node CLI script using `LocalJsonStorage` and `src/engine`. Computes all historical and forecast scores, prints a formatted ASCII summary table of scores, verifies ledger & output SHA-256 hashes, and optionally writes a Markdown export to `dist/HII_Sentiment_Report.md` when `--export` is passed.

Python budget guard module reading/writing `.agents/telemetry/gcp_monthly_spend.json`.
- Enforces hard limit `MONTHLY_BUDGET_CAP_USD = 15.00`.
- Provides `check_budget_available(estimated_cost_usd: float) -> tuple[bool, float, str]` and `record_spend(run_id: str, model: str, cost_usd: float) -> dict`.
- Resets automatically when `YYYY-MM` changes.
Package marker for `research`.

Python REST helper `CloudAgentMesh` using Application Default Credentials (`gcloud auth print-access-token` or `google.auth`) targeting GCP project `gen-lang-client-0353543048`:
- Method `run_deep_research(prompt: str, timeout_sec: int = 180) -> dict`: calls Gemini Interactions API with `agent='deep-research-preview-04-2026'`, `background=True`, and polls until completion.
- Method `run_grounded_generate(prompt: str, model: str = 'gemini-3.8-flash') -> dict`: fallback calling Vertex AI `generateContent` with `tools=[{'googleSearch': {}}]` (supports `gemini-3.8-flash` and `gemini-4-argon`).
- Method `extract_structured_rubric(raw_findings: str, json_schema: dict) -> list[dict]`: calls Vertex AI at `temperature=0.0` with `responseMimeType='application/json'` and `responseSchema=json_schema` to map raw findings into closed-set discrete rubric codes.

Defines audience-specific search and deep-research query packs for HII (Huntington Ingalls Industries, Newport News Shipbuilding, Ingalls Shipbuilding, Mission Technologies):
- `executive`: White House maritime statecraft, OMB defense budget requests, Executive Orders on shipbuilding industrial base, OSD/SecDef briefings.
- `congress`: HASC Seapower / SASC hearings, NDAA shipbuilding authorizations, GAO reports on Ford-class / Virginia-class / Columbia-class delays, CRS naval force structure reports.
- `navy`: SECNAV / CNO 30-Year Shipbuilding Plan, NAVSEA contract awards (CVN-80/81, SSN, DDG-51 Flight III, LHA), shipyard workforce & supplier base reviews.
- `public`: NYSE:HII stock performance vs peers (GD, LMT, NOC, ITA ETF, S&P 500), quarterly earnings releases, Wall Street analyst ratings, national & defense media tone.

Validates and normalizes LLM-extracted candidate events against strict discrete rubric enumerations (`direction in {-1,0,1}`, `magnitude in {1..5}`, `credibility in {1..4}`, `scope in {'program','company','industry','macro'}`, `persistence in {'transient','quarter','year','structural'}`). Computes canonical SHA-256 content ID (`evt_<16hex>`) matching TypeScript `computeEventContentId` and deduplicates against `data/evidence_ledger.json`.

CLI entrypoint invoked by UI or command line (`python3 research/run_research.py --audiences executive,congress,navy,public`).
1. Checks `scripts/gcp_budget_guard.py` ($15/month cap).
2. Attempts `CloudAgentMesh.run_deep_research`, falls back to `run_grounded_generate`, and if running in an offline/unauthenticated environment, produces deterministic curated pending discovery items (including a retroactive historical GAO/CRS event and a recent Q4 2026 event) so the full pending-approval and retroactive-revision workflow can be tested offline.
3. Writes deduplicated candidate events to `data/pending/pending_<runId>.json` and appends run metadata to `data/runs.json`.
